name: Connecting Ridge
height_encoding: uint16 little-endian, row-major, h = min_m + v/65535*(max_m-min_m); row0 = +y edge of polar plane (Z=-size/2)
projection: south polar stereographic, R=1737.4 km, true scale at pole, lon east (x=r sin lon, y=r cos lon)
frame: origin tile centre; +X=plane x; +Z=plane -y; +Y up; heights vs tangent plane at centre

overlays.slope: slope.png: 0..45 deg, 20 m scale, from 5 m DEM
overlays.rough: rough.png: 0..2 m RMS residual (35 m window)
overlays.sun: sun.png: 0..100 % of time Sun disc visible (PGDA 69, 60 m, bicubic upsampled)

source.dem: LOLA Site01 5 m/px, Barker et al. 2021 (PSS 203, 105119), NASA PGDA product 78 https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/78
source.illumination: NASA PGDA product 69 (Mazarico et al. 2011, Icarus 211, 1066), AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 + _EARTH + LPSR
source.note: PGDA product 78 Site01 'Connecting ridge' (Mazarico et al. 2011 site 01)
